claims.text: The source domain is where sufficient labeled data exists, while the target domain is where there is little or no labeled data.
Data in the source and target domains are drawn from different distributions, which is a key challenge in domain adaptation.
The goal of domain adaptation is to learn features that allow a classifier trained on the source domain to be effective in the target domain.
